items.title: Thymosin Alpha-1 may be one of the most studied peptides you’ve never heard of.
items.summary: While many popular peptides have limited human evidence, Thymosin Alpha-1 has been investigated across 30+ clinical studies involving more than 11,000 human subjects. Researchers have explored its effects on the immune system, serious infections, cancer, and other immune-related conditions. But one of the largest trials produced a surprising result. In this video, we break down: 🔬 What Thymosin Alpha-1 actually is 🛡️ Why it's called an “immune peptide” 👥 The research involving 11,000+ human subjects 📊 What earlier studies appeared to show ⚠️ What happened in a 1,106-person Phase 3 sepsis trial 🧬 What the human evidence actually tells us Is Thymosin Alpha-1 really an immune peptide — or have the claims gotten ahead of the evidence? items.title: Launch HN: RonanRX (YC S26) – Personalized Peptides and GLP-1s
items.summary: Hi HN, I’m Lloyd, one of two founders of RonanRx ( https://ronanrx.com/ ). We are building a vertically integrated pharmaceutical company with software for prescribing, telehealth, compounding, manufacturing, and delivery. We are starting with GLP-1s and peptides. The path to RonanRx is fairly unconventional. During the pandemic, I built one of the largest mask manufacturing factories in the US. We could make a million masks in a day. We converted raw polypropylene pellets into finished pallets of masks. I had a background in software from my YC W10 company, so we took a software approach to building our factory. We used machine learning and computer vision to optimize production. We also vertically integrated almost everything. It worked. We built an efficient manufacturing operation and grew the business to 50 million dollars in revenue. Then people actually stopped caring about masks. Fair enough. Around the same time, I decided to try and lose the weight I had gained while building the factory. I ate nothing but chicken for six months. While this diet got some results, I plateaued. My doctor suggested tirzepatide, a GLP-1 medication. For me, losing weight was only the beginning. "Food noise" was gone. I showed less interest in other compulsive behavior. I stopped scrolling Instagram and quit biting my nails. But that was just the beginning. I was born with a congenital heart defect called aortic stenosis. My whole life doctors told me I'd need open heart surgery in my…

items.title: Why Women Experience Anxiety During Hormonal Shifts
items.summary: Anxiety in women can sometimes be closely tied to physiology, especially during major hormonal shifts like puberty, perimenopause, and the second half of the menstrual cycle. Dr. Tania Dempsey explains how hormonal changes and mast cell activity may contribute to these patterns, and why understanding the underlying biology can change how we think about anxiety. #WomensHealth #Hormones #Anxiety #MastCells #FemaleLongevity

items.title: Postmenopausal Women Improved Body Composition With Zero Hormones
items.summary: No hormones, real results, worth sitting with. Dr. Gabrielle Lyon, founder of Muscle-Centric Medicine, shares one of the first studies she ran on postmenopausal women: higher protein, two days of yoga a week, five days of walking. Body composition improved without any hormone replacement involved. This doesn't mean hormones don't matter, it means the basics matter more than we give them credit for. #menopause #protein #womenshealth #longevity #hormonehealth
